verdict.rationale: Gitea's first-party docs describe kanban boards with columns and issues for tracking requirements, features and bugs. Issues support milestones, assignments, due dates, dependencies and time tracking, which spans higher-level planning down to daily tasks. Missing for 10: an explicit roadmap or cross-repository/organization-level board view, in-depth documentation of board configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the project-board workflow.
